title: NIMHANS Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Technical Assistant Posts
description: The National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 02 Technical Assistant and Instrument Attendant Jobs.
